title: Network Realized GARCH--It\^o Models: Volatility Spillovers with High-Frequency Identification
abstract: arXiv:2609.29515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a network realized GARCH-It\^o model in which volatility transmission is a dynamic relation among the latent daily integrated volatilities of multiple assets. An unknown directed and signed network is embedded in a continuous-time variance process and appears in the resulting exponential daily recursion. Intraday returns identify integrated volatility and hence the network that governs its propagation. For a fixed network template, feasible estimation based on realized volatility is first-order equivalent to estimation based on latent integrated volatility. For an unknown network, regularization selects the relevant structure, and, under oracle conditions, a fixed-rank local refit provides conditional inference for model-implied response-based connectedness. translated_title: 网络实现GARCH–伊藤模型：基于高频识别的波动率溢出
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个网络实现GARCH–伊藤模型，其中波动率传导是多个资产的潜在日度积分波动率之间的动态关系。一个未知的、有向且带符号的网络被嵌入到连续时间方差过程中，并出现在由此得到的指数形式日度递推式中。日内收益率可用于识别积分波动率，进而识别支配其传播的网络。对于固定的网络模板，基于已实现波动率的可行估计在一阶意义上等价于基于潜在积分波动率的估计。对于未知网络，正则化方法可筛选出相关的网络结构，并且在oracle条件下，固定秩的局部重拟合方法可为模型隐含的基于响应的关联度提供条件推断。在2007年至2025年九只美国行业ETF的实证应用中，该模型在所报告的递归预测中取得了最低的平均样本外QLIKE，尽管……
tldr: 该论文提出网络实现GARCH–伊藤模型，将未知的有向带符号波动率传导网络嵌入连续时间方差过程，利用高频日内数据识别积分波动率及其网络结构，并给出可行的估计与条件推断方法，在美国行业ETF数据上实现了最优的样本外波动率预测表现。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a network realized GARCH-Itô model that embeds an unknown directed and signed volatility spillover network into a continuous-time variance process, identifies the network structure via high-frequency intraday returns, and provides feasible estimation and conditional inference, achieving the best out-of-sample volatility forecasting performance on U.S. sector ETFs.
